# defectdojo_engagement (Resource)

Manages a DefectDojo engagement, such as the long-lived CI/CD engagement that a pipeline or Dependency-Track imports scans into.

~> **Deleting an engagement deletes its tests and their findings.** The provider refuses to destroy an engagement that has tests unless `force_destroy` is set.

-> **Imports move `target_end`.** Every import into a `CI/CD` engagement moves its `target_end` to the scan date when that is later. Use a `target_end` far in the future, which also keeps DefectDojo from closing the engagement automatically, or `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [target_end] }`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "defectdojo_product" "storefront" {
  name            = "Storefront"
  description     = "The online shop"
  product_type_id = 4
}

# A long-lived engagement that a CI/CD pipeline, or Dependency-Track's
# DefectDojo integration, imports scans into. Imports move target_end to the
# scan date, so it is set far in the future, which also keeps DefectDojo from
# closing the engagement automatically.
resource "defectdojo_engagement" "ci" {
  product_id                  = defectdojo_product.storefront.id
  name                        = "CI/CD"
  engagement_type             = "CI/CD"
  target_start                = "2026-01-01"
  target_end                  = "2099-12-31"
  branch_tag                  = "main"
  source_code_management_uri  = "https://git.example.com/shop/storefront"
  deduplication_on_engagement = true
  tags                        = ["ci"]

  lifecycle {
    # Pipelines and DefectDojo close and reopen engagements.
    ignore_changes = [status]
  }
}

# An interactive engagement, such as a penetration test.
resource "defectdojo_engagement" "pentest" {
  product_id   = defectdojo_product.storefront.id
  name         = "Penetration test 2026"
  target_start = "2026-03-02"
  target_end   = "2026-03-13"
  status       = "Scheduled"
  lead_id      = 12
  description  = "Yearly external penetration test"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the engagement, at most 300 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. Names need not be unique; the `defectdojo_engagement` data source finds engagements by product and name.
- `product_id` (Number) The ID of the product of the engagement. Changing it moves the engagement to another product.
- `target_end` (String) The date the engagement ends, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Every import into a `CI/CD` engagement moves it to the scan date when that is later.
- `target_start` (String) The date the engagement starts, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. It must not be after `target_end`.

### Optional

- `api_test` (Boolean) Whether the engagement includes API tests. Defaults to `true`.
- `branch_tag` (String) The branch or tag the engagement tests, at most 150 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `build_id` (String) The ID of the build the engagement tests, at most 150 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `check_list` (Boolean) Whether the engagement includes a check list. Defaults to `true`.
- `commit_hash` (String) The commit the engagement tests, at most 150 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `deduplication_on_engagement` (Boolean) Whether findings are only deduplicated within the engagement, instead of within the product. Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) The description of the engagement, at most 2000 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `engagement_type` (String) The type of the engagement: `Interactive` or `CI/CD`. DefectDojo uses `Interactive` when it is not set.
- `first_contacted` (String) The date of the first contact, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Whether to destroy the engagement even when it has tests, which DefectDojo then deletes too, with their findings. Defaults to `false`.
- `lead_id` (Number) The ID of the user who leads the engagement, an active user.
- `pen_test` (Boolean) Whether the engagement includes penetration tests. Defaults to `true`.
- `reason` (String) The reason for the engagement, at most 2000 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `source_code_management_uri` (String) The link to the source code the engagement tests, a URL of at most 600 characters.
- `status` (String) The status of the engagement: one of `Not Started`, `Blocked`, `Cancelled`, `Completed`, `In Progress`, `On Hold`, `Scheduled` and `Waiting for Resource`. DefectDojo uses `Not Started` when it is not set. The provider sends it only when the configuration changes it. Pipelines and DefectDojo's automatic closing of engagements change it too: use `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [status] }` for such engagements. Setting it doesn't change `active`: an engagement closed elsewhere stays inactive.
- `tags` (Set of String) The tags of the engagement, each at most 255 characters, without spaces, commas or quotes. Tags are compared ignoring case, and the provider keeps the configured spelling. When the product passes its tags on (`enable_product_tag_inheritance`, or DefectDojo's system setting), DefectDojo adds them to its engagements; the provider hides the product's tags unless they are configured, and a change of the product's tags reaches its engagements later, through DefectDojo's background workers. When it is not set, the provider leaves the tags as they are, so they can be managed elsewhere. An empty set removes them all, including the tags the product passes on.
- `test_strategy` (String) The link to the test strategy of the engagement, a URL of at most 200 characters.
- `threat_model` (Boolean) Whether the engagement includes threat modelling. Defaults to `true`.
- `tracker` (String) The link to the epic or ticket of the engagement, a URL of at most 200 characters.
- `version` (String) The version of the product the engagement tests, at most 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the engagement is open. Closing an engagement in DefectDojo makes it inactive, and reopening it active again.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the engagement.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_engagement.example
  identity = {
    id = 15
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the engagement

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Engagements are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_engagement.example <id>
```
